comment: Until 2003 only Sweden's LME stock changes (MESC 1996-2003) are reported as Sweden, so its flows sit inside Scandinavia. 2004 is excluded because Sweden reports its own flows then. Finland and Norway also report from 2004 and map to ROW, which is never a hub (ADR 0027). #67
